doc: Five distinct values (1, 7, 100, 30 and 117 texels, scattered) on 15x17 = 255 texels: mean ranks 0, 4, 57.5, 122.5 and 196 (half-integers for the even-sized groups), bytes 0, 4, 57, 122, 196 = floor(256 mean / 255). 1.0 and the next float64 above it are DIFFERENT values (exact comparison, no epsilon). Ranks are integers in float64 arithmetic: byte = floor(rank * 256 / n) with the MEAN rank of equal values; byte output: exact.
